product_desc: Intel H610 Motherboard with 6+1+1 Hybrid Digital VRM Design, PCIe 4.0* Design, Gen3 x4 M.2, Anti-Sulfur Resistors, and Smart Fan 6, supporting 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold and Celeron® Processors.

product_features.Supported Processors: 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold and Celeron® Processors
product_features.PCIe Slots: 1 x PCI Express x16 slot (PCIe 4.0, x16 from CPU); 1 x PCI Express x1 slot (PCIe 3.0, x1 from Chipset)
product_features.Storage Interfaces: 1 x M.2 connector (Socket 3, M key, type 2280/2260 PCIe 3.0 x4/x2 SSD support); 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors
product_features.USB Ports: Rear Panel: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 4 x USB 2.0/1.1; Internal Headers: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 4 x USB 2.0/1.1
product_features.Networking: Realtek® GbE LAN chip (1 Gbps/100 Mbps)
product_features.Audio Codec: Realtek® Audio CODEC (High Definition Audio, 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel support)
product_features.Power Phases: 6+1+1 Phases Hybrid Digital VRM Design (with Low RDS(on) MOSFETs)
product_features.Cooling Features: Smart Fan 6 (multiple temperature sensors, hybrid fan headers with FAN STOP, high current support, precision control, dual curve mode)
product_features.BIOS Features: AMI BIOS with new GUI, Q-Flash/Q-Flash Plus, @BIOS, DOS Flash utility, Smart Fan 6 configuration, Tweaker (overclock/overvoltage), Boot Menu, Secure Boot, Easy Mode, Favorites (F11), CPU stability/compatibility updates, Secure Boot Database Key Update
product_features.Expansion Headers: 1 x 24-pin ATX main power connector, 1 x 8-pin ATX 12V power connector, 1 x CPU fan header, 2 x system fan headers, 1 x M.2 Socket 3 connector, 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors, 1 x RGB LED strip header, 1 x front panel header, 1 x front panel audio header, 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header, 2 x USB 2.0/1.1 headers, 1 x Trusted Platform Module header, 1 x serial port header, 1 x Clear CMOS jumper
